phases.name: Adaptation
phases.focus: Adjust to prenatal modifications and moderate intensity

phases.name: Strength Maintenance
phases.focus: Maintain strength with safe, compound movements

phases.name: Preparation
phases.focus: Focus on mobility, stability, and birth preparation

non_negotiables: OB clearance required for moderate strength

stage2.text:
PLAN "Prenatal Strength Maintenance (Advanced Lifter, Weeks 20-32)"
TYPE workout
VISIBILITY public
GOALS
  GOAL primary strength:
    name "Maintain and support strength during pregnancy with safe, compound movements"

PHASES
  PHASE "Adaptation" (3 weeks):
    WEEK 1:
      DAY Monday training 55m "Upper Body":
        warmup:
          arm_circles 5m
        main straight_sets:
          seated_row 3x10 rpe 6 rest 90 seconds
          shoulder_press 3x10 rpe 6 rest 90 seconds
          lat_pulldown 3x12 rpe 6 rest 75 seconds
          tricep_pushdown 2x12 rpe 6 rest 60 seconds
          bicep_curl 2x12 rpe 6 rest 60 seconds
        cooldown:
          chest_stretch 5m
      DAY Wednesday training 55m "Lower Body":
        warmup:
          leg_swings 5m
        main straight_sets:
          goblet_squat 3x12 rpe 6 rest 90 seconds
          romanian_deadlift 3x10 rpe 6 rest 90 seconds
          step_up 3x10 rpe 6 rest 75 seconds
          calf_raise 2x15 rpe 6 rest 60 seconds
        cooldown:
          quad_stretch 5m
      DAY Friday training 55m "Full Body":
        warmup:
          marching 5m
        main straight_sets:
          dumbbell_row 3x10 rpe 6 rest 90 seconds
          split_squat 3x10 rpe 6 rest 90 seconds
          dumbbell_press 3x10 rpe 6 rest 75 seconds
          glute_bridge 2x15 rpe 6 rest 60 seconds
        cooldown:
          hamstring_stretch 5m
      DAY Saturday training 45m "Mobility/Core":
        warmup:
          cat_cow 5m
        main straight_sets:
          bird_dog 3x12 rpe 5 rest 45 seconds
          side_plank 3x30s rpe 5 rest 45 seconds
          pallof_press 3x12 rpe 5 rest 45 seconds
          hip_flexor_stretch 2x30s rpe 5 rest 30 seconds
        cooldown:
          child_pose 5m
